result:
task: Implement DAEO-kl5e (W2-50, FULL): `~/gov-os-runs/<own ticket>/` as the durable scratch root in the guard, in the launcher's sandbox and in the secrets-indexing check, following the approved CIT-P and the owner's answers (DEC-743).

status: DONE. All 154 W2-50 acceptance cases pass. No earlier suite broke because of this change; the only failures are timing cases under load, which pass when re-run alone, and two W1-42 cases that read only documents.

work_completed:
- **`src/gov/guard/runs.py` (new).** It is the one place that names the root and the own folder, for the guard, the launcher and the check:
  - `root()` gives the real path of `~/gov-os-runs`, or `None` when there is no absolute home.
  - `own_folder(project_root, ticket_id, role)` gives `<root>/<external-ref>`, or `<root>/<tk id>` when the ticket has no external-ref. It gives `None` when:
    - the role is not one of the six (`ticket-lead` is not one, DEC-743 7);
    - `GOV_TICKET` is missing, empty or names no ticket;
    - the ticket is not `in_progress` (DEC-743 6);
    - the name is not a single folder name;
    - the root is a link.
  - `holds(own, real)` says whether a real path lies in the own folder, the folder itself included. An existing file with more than one hard link is not held (R8).
- **`src/gov/guard/decide.py`.**
  - `_path_allowed` takes an optional `own`. A target that `runs.holds` accepts is allowed, checked just after the scratch and temp-folder rule. `decide()` works out `own` from the acting role and `GOV_TICKET`.
  - `rmdir` is now read as a Bash write form, but a target counts only when its resolved path is the root itself (R7, scoped to the root). `rmdir` anywhere else is decided as before.
  - The deny reasons are the guard's usual "… to '<path>' denied for role '<role>'".
- **`src/gov/launch/launcher.py`.**
  - Before the session starts, the launcher makes the root and the own folder with `os.makedirs(exist_ok=True)`. It leaves what is there alone, makes no other folder and never removes the own folder.
  - `allowWrite` is `["//<session temp folder>", "//<own folder>"]`. It never holds the root.
  - If the folder cannot be named or made, or turns out to be a link or not a folder, the session gets no own folder: it is neither made nor added. The launch is not refused (see discoveries).
- **`src/gov/secrets/__init__.py`, the link rule only.**
  - The walk over `.gov-runtime/` skips any folder or file whose real path lies in `~/gov-os-runs`. A path that matches only because its name starts with the root's name (for example `~/gov-os-runs-old`) is not skipped.
  - Linked folders elsewhere are still followed (W1-15 B4 stays green).
  - The project's own runtime folder is always scanned, so an adopted clone under the root still scans its own store.
- **`template/governance/kernel/checks/secrets-indexing.yaml`** needed no change.
- **Builder tests**, all with a temporary HOME: 6 test functions (11 cases) in `tests/unit/guard/test_runs.py` and 2 in `tests/unit/launch/test_runs.py`.

files_changed: `src/gov/guard/runs.py` (new), `src/gov/guard/decide.py`, `src/gov/launch/launcher.py`, `src/gov/secrets/__init__.py`, `tests/unit/guard/test_runs.py` (new), `tests/unit/launch/test_runs.py` (new).

tests: every run uses `PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src` set per command and runs to its end, never with `-x`. Suites marked "-n 8" ran in parallel with pytest-xdist because several take longer than the 10-minute foreground limit when run one case at a time.
- **W2-50:** 154 passed, run twice (the second time after the final launcher change).
- **Unit (`tests/unit`):** 2113 passed, 1 skipped (-n 8). The new builder tests: 13 passed.
- **W1-03:** 363 passed, 1 skipped (it needs a `gov` package found without PYTHONPATH).
- **W1-02:** 3653 passed (-n 8). Its latency file `test_w1_02_guard_hook.py` alone: 7 passed.
- **W1-05:** 1 failed and 98 passed in the first run. The failure was its nested run of W1-02, W1-03 and W1-04 with `-x`, which stopped at collection position 616, `test_decision_p95_is_under_100_ms`, a latency case. A second whole run went past the 590-second limit and was stopped.
  - The rest of W1-05, with that one case left out: 97 passed, 1 failed. The failure was the `test_a_call_waits_under_100_ms_p95_for_the_hook[NotebookEdit-engineer]` latency case. Run alone, all 9 `100_ms` cases passed.
  - So W1-05 never had one complete green run. Its pieces did pass: W1-02, W1-03 and W1-04 each pass alone, and the latency case passes alone.
- **W1-15**, all of it, including the `local_only` gitleaks cases and B4: 123 passed, 1 failed (-n 8). The failure was the 15-second time limit in `test_w1_15_parallel_scan.py`. That file alone: 8 passed.
- **W1-28:** 151 passed. **W1-32:** 80 passed. **W1-46:** 457 passed. **W1-48:** 164 passed. **W1-50:** 683 passed. These four launcher-heavy suites (W1-28, W1-32, W1-46, W1-50) ran again after the final launcher change with the same counts. All ran -n 8 without `local_only`.
- **Others that touch the guard, launcher or check** (-n 8, without `local_only`):
  - W1-01: 49 passed, 28 skipped. W1-04: 336 passed. W1-07: 215 passed. W1-16: 6 passed. W1-17: 62 passed. W1-19: 35 passed. W1-27: 132 passed. W1-30: 512 passed. W1-47: 983 passed. W1-49: 94 passed.
  - W1-26: 412 passed, 1 skipped. W1-33: 113 passed. W1-38: 201 passed. These three ran again after the launcher change with the same counts.
- **W1-42:** 2 failed, 22 passed. The failing cases are `test_retrieval_query_ran_with_bundles_expansions_notes_and_stopping_reason[RETR-X-02]` ("no named parent expansion (DEC-091)") and `test_governance_share_is_measured_and_at_most_15_percent_on_each_programme`. The suite reads only `docs/plan/wave-1-exit/` documents and runs no code this change touches.
- **Not run:** the `local_only` cases of W1-46 (`test_w1_46_live_sessions.py`), of W1-50 (one live case in `test_w1_50_freeze_launcher.py` and one in `test_w1_50_freeze_live_pause.py`) and of W1-16. They start real Claude sessions with the real HOME, so they would now create the real `~/gov-os-runs`.

discoveries:
- **The live `local_only` launch cases** (W1-46 `test_w1_46_live_sessions.py`; W1-50 `test_a_launched_session_leaves_no_placeholder_at_the_flag_s_path` and `test_a_flag_put_over_the_placeholder_during_a_command_stays`) run `gov launch` with the real HOME. From this commit on, such a run creates the real `~/gov-os-runs/<fixture ticket's W2 id>/`, for example `W1-90`. Anyone who runs them should know that first.
- **The launcher does not refuse a launch for a missing own folder.** The earlier unit fixtures in `tests/unit/launch/test_w1_28.py` and `test_w1_32.py` replace the ticket check and have no ticket file. A refusal turned 10 of them red. The brief says doubt means no own folder, never an allowance, so a missing folder now means none is opened.
- **A clone adopted under the root runs its own secrets check from inside the root.** If the check skipped everything whose real path lies in the root, it would scan nothing there. So the project's own runtime folder is always scanned.

risks:
- Each judged write now reads the session's ticket a second time. The latency cases pass alone but failed under parallel load, as the brief expected.
- `rmdir` whose operand cannot be resolved (for example `rmdir "$UNSET"`) is still not judged, as before. `rmdir` can only remove an empty root.
- If a launched session's own folder cannot be opened, the session starts without it and gives no warning line.

lessons:
- W1-05 cannot finish in one 10-minute foreground call, because it reruns W1-02, W1-03 and W1-04 one after another. Run those three directly (W1-02 with `-n 8`) and leave out W1-05's nested case.
- Every `local_only` live launch now makes the real `~/gov-os-runs`. Use `-m "not local_only"` unless you mean to make it.

proposed_decisions:
- **Package 1, the live launch cases and the real root.**
  - Question: may the `local_only` live launch cases of W1-46 and W1-50 create the real `~/gov-os-runs/<fixture id>/` when someone runs them?
  - Why now: from this commit on they do, and this run's rule was that nobody creates the real root.
  - Options: (a) accept it, and whoever runs them removes the fixture folder afterwards; (b) a later ticket gives those cases a temporary HOME, though the real CLI and its sign-in live in the real HOME; (c) leave those cases out until W2-21's launch work.
  - Impact: a stray folder in the durable root. Reversibility: the owner removes it by hand. Cost: (a) none, (b) a test change counted under DEC-106.
  - Recommendation: (a) for now, and record a list row for W2-21. Confidence: medium.

unresolved: W1-05 has not had one complete green run; its pieces each pass, as listed under tests. The two W1-42 failures stand apart from this ticket. `docs/changes/W2-50-CIT-E.md` is not written, as the brief said for this round.

recommended_next_action: The lead starts the fresh FULL probe of commit `91200c82` and then has the CIT-E written. The probe should not run the live `local_only` launch cases with the real HOME unless Package 1 is answered.
